laws.rule: Consuming, producing or transporting alcohol is illegal in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Drinking or possessing alcohol there can mean arrest without bail and 5 to 10 years' prison.

sources.title: India travel advice: safety and security
sources.authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
sources.supports: alcohol is illegal in Bihar, Gujarat, Mizoram, Nagaland and Lakshadweep; 5 to 10 years' prison (read directly)
